subject: alt-c-prog
title: (R)ALT.C.PROG.------TRS.
description: Diagram in PCC-27. (R)ALT-C-PG — the reality of alternative composite progressionalism — is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram poses what *real* alternative composite progressionalism (not just the concept) requires when crossed with transition. ALT-C-PG → T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → TRS (the crossing) → MT-INFO (music information) → (R)MTA-IMP (the reality of meta-implications) → RT-IMP (reality implications). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) has a *dashed* edge to TRS — registering that the link from social-reality-dynamics to transition is conditional, not direct. TRS also → COS-AGN (cosmic assignment) and TRS → (R)INT (the reality of intention) → EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). Structural argument: real alternative composite progressionalism produces transition only via time-continuum implications. Transition's productive outputs are music information (which leads to real meta-implications and reality implications), cosmic assignment, and real intention (which produces expansion dynamics). The dashed edge from social reality dynamics to transition is critical: it marks that social reality alone does not reliably produce transition — only conditionally. The diagram thus diagrams Braxton's structural claim that real alt-c-pg → transition is mediated by time-continuum implications, not by social-reality-dynamics directly. This corrects the gradualist temptation to think that social-reality-dynamics shifts will automatically produce transition: they will, only conditionally, and only if time-continuum implications carry the load.
